purpose: ctx.files of a label-list attribute (StarlarkAttributesCollection.addAttribute, analysis/starlark/StarlarkAttributesCollection.java:398-409, over PrerequisiteArtifacts.nestedSet, PrerequisiteArtifacts.java:64-72): a stable-order NestedSet of every prerequisite's files to build, so each File appears once, at its first occurrence in prerequisite order; also the aspect's ctx.rule.files and the built-in dependency attributes. Motivation (review finding): `deps = [":gen", ":fg"]` with fg a filegroup over gen gave genuine ["pkg/gen.txt"] but natively the file twice, which reaches action inputs and command lines (`arguments = [f.path for f in ctx.files.deps]`).

reference.environment: env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME/TMPDIR private LANG=C.UTF-8 LC_ALL=C.UTF-8; one fresh copy of the fixture workspace per case (the genuine platforms 1.0.0 module extracted into `platforms` from tests/fixtures/label_repo_name/platforms_archive.json)

normalization: <WS> = the case's workspace copy; <OB> = the genuine output base; <CACHE> = the native cache; elapsed times <T>. Outputs are the top-level outputs (genuine --show_result lines, bazel-bin = bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/bin; native LABEL<TAB>PATH lines below the action output root) as [mode, contents].
comparison (tests/label_list_files.rs, l: MATCH: success equal; WARNING lines equal in order; a failing case's genuine message (the `Error in <callable>: ` / `Error: ` Starlark text, else the rule error following an empty `in KIND rule L: ` line, else the first ERROR message) is contained in native stderr; built top-level outputs (path below bazel-out -> [mode, contents]) equal; a `test` case's stdout (the test summary, ` in N.Ns` run times as ` in <T>s`) equal. DECLARED_DIVERGENCE: native fails with the recorded message.
genuine_key_findings: A filegroup over another prerequisite's file, either order, an alias of a prerequisite, and a source file listed directly and through a filegroup each give one File (deps=["pkg/gen.txt"], ["pkg/a.txt"]); first occurrence wins: [fg_multi(m1, m2, gen), gen, multi] gives [m1, m2, gen]; distinct prerequisites keep their order; ctx.attr keeps every Target (an alias's Target has the actual's label).
The command line and inputs of an action built from ctx.files list each file once (the .args output).
An aspect's ctx.rule.files of the same attribute is deduplicated alike; label_keyed_string_dict files (dict) and a single label (one) were already one entry each.
known_divergences: Native prints its own result format (`LABEL\tPATH`, `bazel-rs: N actions executed ...`), no INFO lines.
Native is passed --experimental-builtin-modules in every case (as in the other paired fixtures).
